_comments: Marks the three PaymentDetail hosts as Embedded Records (MJ 6.2).
Customer Payment Method.PaymentDetailID is required (wallet is a thin host).
Payment Header.PaymentDetailID and Order Header.InitialPaymentDetailID are optional.
OnClear is delete: D39 copy-on-use, unique 1:1 per host, never shared.

migration has been applied to this database, then run CodeGen so the generated
classes emit {Field}_Object / {Field}_EnsureObject. Until then the same
declarations live on the shared entity subclasses.
